
=== progression tables ===
progression
  Threshold: 5
  Warrior:
    - {Min: 1, Max: 2, Key: "noChange", Name: "No Change", Text: "The Warrior does not gain a promotion."}
    -
      Min: 3
      Max: 5
      Key: "promoted"
      Name: "Promoted"
      Text: "The Warrior has been granted a promotion by the leader of the company. Check the Advancements table on the company's page: the Warrior exchanges all characteristics and wargear for the new profile, while retaining any wargear that the new profile allows. A Warrior eligible for several promotions picks one. If there is no promotion, the Warrior increases Courage & Intelligence by +1 each, to a maximum of 3+."
    -
      Min: 6
      Max: 6
      Key: "heroInTheMaking"
      Name: "A Hero in the Making"
      Text: "The Warrior is treated as a Hero and immediately gains 1 Might, Will, and Fate point. They retain their Experience Points and advance like a Hero from the next game on. Alternatively the model may forgo the Hero's Journey and take their Promotion instead."
  NoPromotion: ["courage", "intelligence"]
  NoPromotionTo: 3

Whilst this Hero is within 12\" of, and has Line of Sight to, the chosen Hero, whenever the chosen Hero declares a Heroic Action they must roll a D6. On a 1-2, the Heroic Action is immediately cancelled and the Might Point is not spent. The chosen Hero may not then attempt to declare the same Heroic Action again that turn."
          Options: [{Type: "specialRule", Amount: 1, Rule: "Spy"}]

If they would normally win the roll-off on a 4+, they will instead win it on a 3+. If they would normally win the roll-off on a 1, 2, or 3, they will instead win the roll-off on a 1, 2, 3, or 4.  2 ok=no "Spy (Active) - At the beginning of the game, after both sides have deployed, this Hero may choose one enemy Hero in your opponent's Company. If they would normally win the roll-off on a 4+, they will instead win it on a 3+. If they would normally win the roll-off on a 1, 2, or 3, they will instead win the roll-off on a 1, 2, 3, or 4. === path Path of the Duelist: what each 2D6 result offers a fresh hero ===
 2 ok=no "Grim Blade (Active) - This Hero will always win the roll-off during a Drawn Combat. If both sides have a Hero with this special rule, neither side will benefit from this special rule.": 
 3 ok=no "For Glory (Active) - Once per game, at the start of any Fight Phase, this Hero can use this special rule so long as they are alive and on the battlefield. If they do, then friendly Battle Company models within 6\" of this Hero gain a bonus of +1 Fight Value and may reroll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes until the end of the turn.": 
 4 ok=yes "Improve Attacks or Wounds by 1.": stat:attack:-1=Attack 1 → 2; stat:wounds:-1=Wounds 1 → 2
 5 ok=yes "Improve Courage or Intelligence by 1 (& take your other roll too!)": stat:courage:1=Courage 7+ → 6+(+again); stat:intelligence:1=Intelligence 7+ → 6+(+again)
 6 ok=yes "Improve Strength or Defence by 1.": stat:defence:-1=Defence 5 → 6; stat:strength:-1=Strength 3 → 4

 2 ok=no "Whirl of Attacks (Active) - When rolling a natural 6 for their Duel Roll, this Hero increases their Attacks by 1 for that Fight. This rule cannot be used if the enemy model is Trapped.":

 5 ok=yes "Improve Courage or Intelligence by 1 (do not take the second result!)": stat:courage:1=Courage 7+ → 6+; stat:intelligence:1=Intelligence 7+ → 6+
